name: Kinto K token unprotected initializer takeover
summary: The K proxy was deployed with its implementation active but initialize() still callable by anyone. Two seconds later an attacker initialized it, assigned the administrative roles to its helper, and upgraded to a clandestine implementation. The retained authority later installed code that wrote unbacked K directly into an attacker balance for monetization.

loss.notes: The canonical $1.55 million figure is the reported gross loss. An independent component reconstruction covers 790,148 USDC borrowed from Morpho Blue without repayment plus approximately 282.84 ETH drained from K liquidity pools and values to about $1.58 million because the published asset quantities are rounded.

ageReset.description: The proxy's creation transaction emitted Upgraded(address) at log 0 and selected K implementation 0x1a16bcddd1bf92049e2a44e136081061eeace7c0. It remained active and uninitialized until the attacker called initialize() two seconds later.

sources.note: Reviewed the takeover and loss receipts and traces, the proxy deployment, every Upgraded event, implementation-slot values across the full deployment-to-loss interval, K balances and totalSupply, and downstream loss reconstruction. The Kinto deployer created proxy 0x010700ab046dd8e92b0e3587842080df36364ed3 at block 317434592:1; its Upgraded log 0 selected implementation 0x1a16bcddd1bf92049e2a44e136081061eeace7c0, whose runtime hashes to 0x64e607ba1c96946a4f1329a5c02b9f040b2a44f7f0ffc8aca41a0fe253be5340 in the deployment and takeover blocks. Two seconds later, transaction 0xd17330df683adeec26a67ff6972a74ab60a1e5577c73d0e074d8e890fab5279c at block 317434602:3 called the proxy's initialize(string,string,address,address,address) through helper 0x2fc427b354350c0186ce39bdb9e260b7d01036c9. The trace delegates that call to the recorded implementation; the receipt grants the default-admin, minter and upgrader roles to the helper and emits Initialized(1). A historical eth_call from an unrelated address against the pre-takeover block succeeds with arbitrary role recipients, proving initialize() had no caller authorization. The helper then called upgradeToAndCall and installed clandestine implementation 0x7382bcbd6b361e218e1c1c3180201c2da6f3d210. Later silent writes selected 0x95fa23bb5e88ebc4a5fcf1210ccc526938e7dc58 and then 0xe343c368c483da30a84d845eb3d2a209fbf6a683. The final loss transaction enters the K proxy and delegates to the latter, writing 999999999999999983222784 K directly into 0x6eb3731b52c8556073baa13d9e35d5a6713fc8ab's balance without a Transfer event or totalSupply change. The loss reconstruction separates 790,148 USDC forwarded from unpaid Morpho borrowing and approximately 282.84 ETH of pool proceeds, excluding ETH obtained by swapping that same USDC. The curve ages the victim's reachable unprotected initializer from proxy activation to its first successful call; the later attacker-authored implementations are loss machinery, not the age basis.

limitations: The USDC and ETH components aggregate downstream monetization and are recorded to the precision supported by the public post-mortem and transfer reconstruction.
